all_word_geometry: For M=64, J in {0,...,64}, D is integer, D<=J. Therefore J>0 and 512D>=J iff D>=1. The first six feature counts give J and C and D exactly; endpoint first bit F is coordinate 7 (one-indexed). Q=0.125+0.75*(C/J if D>=1 else F), proving no feature collisions with different Q on all valid words.
